description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
When Phantasmal Image enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.name: Phantasmal Image
uses.cardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead
